title: espmap.ensemble/1 (DRAFT for review, step 4 of docs/ensemble-spec.md)
description: One conformer ensemble of one molecule, every member an ordinary espmap.record/1 written beside this file and listed with its sha256, so an archive can check each member without trusting this record. Field names follow the Atlas's spa.espmap_ensemble/0 index where the two describe the same thing (marked 'Atlas:'). Additions from review 6's 'before espmap.ensemble/1 is frozen' list are marked 'R6:'. NOT the Atlas's 'protocol': there it is a string, the consumer's own directory label (e.g. b3lyp_def2-svp_gas_espmap-v0.2.1), derived from analysis and espmap.version and never stored here. Here 'protocol' is how the members were chosen. Do not map one onto the other.

subject.description: opaque caller label (--subject), copied verbatim, never parsed, not in ensemble_key. The Atlas would pass its atlas_id here.

ensemble_key.description: sha1 of (analysis_key, protocol minus timings): two callers computing the same ensemble get the same key

analysis_key.description: Atlas: analysis_key. Every member record carries it; a member that does not is refused, never averaged (E10)

analysis.description: Atlas: analysis. The members' key_fields.analysis, identical across members

espmap.description: Atlas: espmap.version (+ commit). RDKit and PySCF versions, because member_id is stable only within them (ETKDG output changes between RDKit releases)

smiles.description: Atlas: smiles. Canonical isomeric SMILES of the approved structure: THE identity check, every member's computed structure must match it

inchikey.description: Atlas: inchikey. A label only: standard InChI merges mobile-H tautomers (E8)

charge.description: R6 S2: the one formal charge every member shares

atom_maps.description: R6 S2: heavy-atom maps in atom order (0 = unmapped), shared; sites keyed by map rely on it

configuration.description: R6 S1: configuration_signs, the stereo elements RDKit does not perceive (small-ring trans helicity, cumulene axes, biaryl axes), shared by every member. {} when there are none

isotopes.description: R6 S11: isotope labels are not part of identity (the ESP cannot see them). Placeholder until S11 picks the rule; the field forces the choice to be stated

n_other_configuration.description: R6 S1: embedded conformers dropped because they were not the 3D input's configuration

method.description: Atlas: selection.method, as one readable sentence, e.g. 'lowest MMFF + 9 across Rg of 100 ETKDG, heavy-atom RMSD 0.5 A'

rg_definition.description: R6 S4: the selection key, which is not the per-member rg_angstrom

dedup_atoms.description: R6 S4: the dedup population; null exactly when dedup_rmsd_A is null (no deduplication)

symmetry_match_cap.description: R6 S5: reaching it refuses, so the list here is never truncated

dedup_status.description: the dedup threshold's status; null when there is no dedup

weighting.description: MMFF never weights. dft only with optimized members

status.description: provisional until measured; measured since docs/ensemble-spec.md 8.2

source.description: where the rule's parameters were measured

folded_rule.description: R6 S3: folded names its rule and parameters. A consumer with a free-text field (the Atlas's selection.notes) renders it there, e.g. 'folded: heavy-atom contact >= 6 bonds apart, Bondi + 0.5 A; measured, espmap ensemble-spec 8.2'

conformer.description: Atlas: conformer. Zero-based, in selection order: conf_00 is the lowest MMFF for a generated ensemble, record 1 for a supplied one. Zero-based so that files already written under the Atlas's spa.espmap_ensemble/0 (espmap-sesiidae-001: conf_00..conf_19, conf_00 lowest MMFF) stay valid under this schema

member_id.description: sha1 of the geometry in verified-mapping atom order

embed_conf_id.description: generated: the embedder's conformer id (with the seed, the identity across RDKit versions)

source_record.description: supplied: the file's record number (R6 S6: file numbering)

geometry_sha1.description: Atlas: geometry_sha1, the member record's geometry.sha1

rg_angstrom.description: Atlas: rg_angstrom. Heavy atoms, unweighted (spec section 3); null with no heavy atom

folded.description: Atlas: folded. Has a contact under folded_rule

genus_excess.description: genus minus that of the most extended member; a diagnostic, not the rule

configuration.description: R6 S1: this member's configuration_signs; must equal identity.configuration

validity.description: the member record's validity block, copied

attempts.description: member runs logged for this conformer (run_log.jsonl); 0 when it was done by an earlier invocation that left no log

earlier_failures.description: every failed attempt, '<kind>, rc <n>: <last stderr line>'. Only an infrastructure failure (killed, no record) is retried; a deterministic one stays excluded across reruns, since rerunning until it passes would be selection on outcome

source_record.description: R6 S6: an unreadable supplied record by its file number

attempts.description: member runs logged for this conformer (run_log.jsonl); 0 when it was done by an earlier invocation that left no log

earlier_failures.description: every failed attempt, '<kind>, rc <n>: <last stderr line>'. Only an infrastructure failure (killed, no record) is retried; a deterministic one stays excluded across reruns, since rerunning until it passes would be selection on outcome

excluded.description: never silently dropped; validity.bias is false whenever any excluded member is folded

convergence.description: spec section 5; shape settled with the runner

kish_n.description: (sum w)^2 / sum w^2, dft weighting only

results.description: per member and over members: V_min, V_max, surface stats; populations 'all' and 'extended'

sites.description: keyed by site definition (maps included), per partition rule, per population: per-member means, then mean, sd (ddof 1), min, max, range, n

unbiased.description: false whenever any excluded member is folded (F9: the chi = 2 check once excluded exactly the folded C18 members). Was 'bias' in the spec draft; renamed so that true reads as fine, like every other validity flag
